body.en: Settings › Appearance › Theme now picks a palette as well as light or dark: Lattice's own, Rosé Pine or Nord, or a .lattice-theme.json theme you install from a file. A theme brings its own accent, and an accent you pick yourself is adjusted to stay readable on the theme's colors.
body.zh: 设置 › 外观 › 主题现在除了浅色或深色，还可以选择配色：Lattice 自带的配色、Rosé Pine、Nord，或从文件安装的 .lattice-theme.json 主题。主题自带强调色；你自己选的强调色会自动调整，以便在主题的配色上保持清晰可读。

body.en: Settings › Appearance › Browse themes… lists themes from the Lattice theme registry, installs them in one click and offers updates. The list is signed: Lattice refuses a list that fails its signature or is older than one it has already seen, and keeps the last verified list when you're offline. If a theme is withdrawn, Lattice turns it off and says why in Settings. Themes with a known problem stay on and show a warning.
body.zh: 设置 › 外观 › 浏览主题… 会列出 Lattice 主题仓库中的主题，一键安装并提示更新。主题列表带有签名：签名校验失败、或比已见过的列表更旧的列表都会被拒绝；离线时沿用最后一次校验通过的列表。如果某个主题被撤下，Lattice 会将其关闭并在设置中说明原因。存在已知问题的主题仍保持启用，并显示警告。

body.en: Settings › Plugins installs a plugin from a folder or a URL, and lists the permissions it asks for in plain words before you turn it on. An enabled plugin adds its commands to the command palette, and any change it makes to your bibliography is shown for you to confirm and can be undone.
body.zh: 设置 › 插件可以从文件夹或网址安装插件，并在启用前用通俗的语言列出它请求的权限。启用的插件会把命令加入命令面板；它对参考文献所做的任何修改都会先展示给你确认，并且可以撤销。

body.en: Boards now open, edit and save as .excalidraw files. A .tldr board opens as an .excalidraw copy converted beside it, and the original is left as it was.
body.zh: 白板现在以 .excalidraw 文件打开、编辑和保存。.tldr 白板会在旁边转换出一份 .excalidraw 副本并打开它，原文件保持不变。

title.en: Project tabs come back after a restart
title.zh: 重启后恢复项目标签页

body.en: After Quit or Restart, Lattice reopens each window's project tabs in their order, with the same one selected. Thanks to @knightnemo (#1094).
body.zh: 退出或重启后，Lattice 会按原来的顺序重新打开每个窗口的项目标签页，并选中原来的那一个。感谢 @knightnemo（#1094）。

title.en: TeX updates ask for your password once
title.zh: TeX 更新只需输入一次密码

body.en: The first TeX Live update or package install that needs your password also makes you the owner of the TeX Live folder, so later updates install without asking. Lattice now checks for updates weekly instead of daily, and MacTeX gets the same one-click update.
body.zh: 第一次需要密码的 TeX Live 更新或宏包安装会同时把 TeX Live 文件夹的所有者改为你，之后的更新无需再输入密码即可安装。Lattice 现在每周而不是每天检查一次更新，MacTeX 也能一键更新。

title.zh: 自选 Overleaf 项目的下载位置

body.en: Open from Overleaf shows the folder a project will download into, and Choose… picks another. The next download offers the same folder again.
body.zh: “从 Overleaf 打开”会显示项目将下载到的文件夹，点击“选择…”可以换一个。下次下载会默认使用同一个文件夹。

body.en: Settings › Appearance › Tab style draws panel tabs filled, as before, or outlined, so you can count the open tabs at a glance. History › Compare versions has a Wrap toggle for long source lines. Thanks to @ivanvykopal for the Wrap toggle (#1120).
body.zh: 设置 › 外观 › 标签页样式可以把面板标签页显示为填充（与之前相同）或描边，方便一眼数清打开了几个标签页。历史 › 对比版本新增“自动换行”开关，用于显示较长的源码行。感谢 @ivanvykopal 提供自动换行开关（#1120）。

fixes.en: In a project with more than one root document, the PDF preview reopens each document on its own page when a build switches to it, instead of the page the other one was on.
fixes.zh: 在有多个根文档的项目中，编译切换到另一个文档时，PDF 预览会回到该文档自己的页面，而不是停在另一个文档所在的页码。

fixes.en: Saving a chapter builds the root document that includes it, not the root that was built last, so a paper's section no longer compiles its rebuttal.
fixes.zh: 保存某个章节时，会编译包含它的根文档，而不是上一次编译的根文档，因此论文的章节不会再编译成 rebuttal。

fixes.en: A project stays linked to Overleaf after its title is renamed on Overleaf.
fixes.zh: 在 Overleaf 上重命名项目标题后，项目仍保持与 Overleaf 关联。

fixes.en: Clicking a document tab hands its editor the keyboard, so you can type straight away instead of clicking into the text first.
fixes.zh: 点击文档标签页后，键盘会交给该文档的编辑器，可以直接输入，不必先点一下正文。

fixes.en: Clicking into the PDF page number and leaving it unchanged no longer jumps to the top of the page.
fixes.zh: 点进 PDF 页码框但不做修改就离开，不再跳到该页顶部。

fixes.en: Selecting a very long passage no longer makes the editor stall while macOS checks it for Writing Tools. Thanks to @wchen99998 for the diagnosis (#1115).
fixes.zh: 选中很长的一段文字时，编辑器不再因 macOS 检查写作工具（Writing Tools）而卡顿。感谢 @wchen99998 的诊断（#1115）。

fixes.en: REVTeX's generated <job>Notes.bib no longer shows up in the file tree. Thanks to @ajay-mk for the fix (#1106).
fixes.zh: REVTeX 生成的 <job>Notes.bib 不再出现在文件树中。感谢 @ajay-mk 提供修复（#1106）。

fixes.en: Importing files whose names are already taken asks with one row of buttons instead of a list and an Import button.
fixes.zh: 导入的文件与已有文件重名时，现在用一行按钮询问，而不再是列表加“导入”按钮。

fixes.en: Windows: the terminal starts in the project folder when the folder name contains brackets. Thanks to @ivanvykopal for the fix (#1023).
fixes.zh: Windows：项目文件夹名称包含方括号时，终端也会在项目文件夹中启动。感谢 @ivanvykopal 提供修复（#1023）。
